reached_sql:
SELECT
  customer.c_last_name,
  customer.c_first_name,
  customer.c_salutation,
  customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
  dj.ss_ticket_number,
  dj.cnt
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_sales.ss_ticket_number,
    store_sales.ss_customer_sk,
    count(*) AS cnt
  FROM date_dim
  JOIN store_sales
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND (
        household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
        OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
      )
      AND household_demographics.hd_dep_count / household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 1
  ) AS hd
    ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN store
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
    AND date_dim.d_year IN (2000, 2000+1, 2000+2)
    AND store.s_county IN ('Williamson County', 'Williamson County', 'Williamson County', 'Williamson County')
  GROUP BY store_sales.ss_ticket_number, store_sales.ss_customer_sk
) AS dj
JOIN customer
  ON dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, customer.c_last_name ASC
